g.text: Adaptation quality versus operational cost · 50 future tasks
Body-term probes; full released corpora; descriptive means across document-sampling seeds.
Each point is a recorded budget; lines connect measured configurations. Panel y-axis ranges differ.
Operations count target sampling and searches, not wall time, token cost, or source training.
